response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with some low-level background (C/C++ at National Instruments, DLang for high-performance/async services) and relevant geospatial domain exposure via GISCollective, but his recent and predominant experience is in TypeScript/Node.js web development rather than modern C++ or Rust in a routing/navigation or distributed-systems context. The role requires deep, current C++/Rust expertise and production-grade routing/navigation pipeline work, which is not well represented in this resume.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk)
Strong systems-level background including C/C++ work and high-performance async DLang services handling millions of requests/sec
Broad technical range and demonstrated ability to learn new stacks (web, mobile, embedded, backend)
concerns: No recent or substantial modern C++ or Rust experience; most recent roles are TypeScript/Node.js focused
No evident experience with routing/navigation-specific pipelines, tiling, or real-time traffic integration
Limited explicit exposure to distributed-systems concepts like fault tolerance, consistency, and service discovery at scale

key_factors.factor: Lack of current C++/Rust production experience
